headline: Brent Crude Plunges 16% to $98 per Barrel in Worst Weekly Decline Since Pandemic
summary: Brent crude oil futures dropped 16% over the week to settle near $98 per barrel following US midterm election results, marking the largest weekly oil drop since the 2020 pandemic.
why: Brent crude is the primary price benchmark for global petroleum supplies.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Increased prospects of Middle Eastern de-escalation led to massive selling in global crude contracts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A dramatic shift in geopolitical risk premiums post-US midterms sparked aggressive liquidation of long crude positions.
